notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional interaction subscription-replacement surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that a queued interaction admitted under receiver region A is suppressed after replacement by disjoint region B, that a later source-B interaction is delivered exactly once with replacement source-region metadata and message metadata, and that interaction delivery precedes the matching time-advance grant without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction subscription replacement with conveyed region-designator sets and FederateAmbassador receive and time-advance-grant callbacks
